{{Description|Large Brown Egg}} |source = [[Chicken]] |edibility = 15 |sellprice = 95 }} The '''Large Egg''' and the '''Large Brown Egg''' are [[:Category:Animal Products|animal products]] obtained from [[Chicken]]s with sufficient [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. Large Eggs produce Quality [[Mayonnaise]] when used with a [[Mayonnaise Machine]]. Large Eggs can be hatched in an [[incubator]], which comes with a Big or Deluxe [[Coop]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Caroline,Clint,Elliott,Emily,Evelyn,George,Gus,Harvey,Krobus,Leo,Lewis,Maru,Penny,Robin,Sandy,Willy |like=Demetrius,Linus,Pierre,Alex,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie |hate=Sebastian |dislike=Abigail,Pam,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Dwarf,Wizard }} ==Artisan Goods== :''See also: [[Animal Products Profitability]]'' Large Eggs can be used to make the following [[Artisan Goods]]. Note that regular [[Egg]]s always produce regular quality [[Mayonnaise]], while Large Eggs always produce gold-quality [[Mayonnaise]]. The quality of the egg is not a factor. {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredient !Equipment !Time !Sell Price |- |[[File:Mayonnaise.png|center]] |[[Mayonnaise]] |{{Description|Mayonnaise}} |{{Name|Egg|1|class=inline}} ''or''{{Name|Large Egg|1}} |style="text-align: center;" |[[File:Mayonnaise Machine.png|center|40px|link=]][[Mayonnaise Machine]] |{{duration|3 Hours}} |{{Qualityprice|Mayonnaise|190|hide=silver,iridium|dsv=false}} |} ==Bundles== *Large Egg and Large Brown Egg are both options for the {{Bundle|Animal||y}}. *Ten Eggs (any type, excluding Dinosaur) are required for the {{Bundle|homecook||y}}. ==Recipes== Large Eggs work the same as regular chicken [[Egg|eggs]] in all recipes.{{#lsth:Egg|Recipes}} ==Tailoring== Large Egg can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt218.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Cardigan]]. Both colors of large eggs can be used as a white [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== *[[Quests#Gus' Famous Omelet|"Gus' Famous Omelet"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], [[Gus]] may randomly request that the player collect and deliver 24 Eggs (of any type) to the fridge in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]. The reward is {{Price|3000}} and a [[Mini-Fridge]]. *Five Eggs (any type, excluding Dinosaur) may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his third request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.1|Increased value from {{Price|75}} to {{Price|95}}.}} {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can be used for a [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Order]] and the Home Cook's Bundle.}} {{History|1.6|Can be used for a Raccoon request.}} {{NavboxAnimals}} [[Category:Animal Products]] [[de:Großes Ei]] [[es:Huevo XXL]] [[fr:Gros oeuf]] [[it:Uovo grande]] [[ja:おおきなタマゴ]] [[ko:큰 달걀]] [[hu:Nagy tojás]] [[pt:Ovo Grande]] [[ru:Большое яйцо]] [[tr:Büyük Yumurta]] [[zh:大鸡蛋]]
